tasks.name: table tennis

collect.command: t0=$(date +%s); while [ ! -f /data/server.pid ] && [ $(( $(date +%s) - t0 )) -lt 120 ]; do sleep 2; done; i=0; while [ $(( $(date +%s) - t0 )) -lt 300 ] && ! grep -q '"finalized": true' /data/final.json 2>/dev/null; do [ $((i % 15)) -eq 0 ] && kill -USR1 $(cat /data/server.pid 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null; i=$((i + 1)); sleep 2; done; while [ $(( $(date +%s) - t0 )) -lt 870 ] && grep -q '"video_pending": true' /data/final.json 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done; cat /data/final.json
